mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDPC1 (real GDP) indicates strong economic growth, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns as corporate earnings are likely to improve.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative during periods of GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in UNRATE (unemployment rate) below 4.5% signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and higher S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not higher when UNRATE is below 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS (federal funds rate) is high and UNRATE is low, it indicates a strong economy with tight monetary policy, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns as higher rates could reduce corporate borrowing and investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive when FEDFUNDS is high and UNRATE is low (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising FEDFUNDS indicates tighter monetary policy, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns as higher interest rates reduce the present value of future corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in PAYEMS (nonfarm employment) indicates a strong labor market, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns as consumer spending and corporate revenues are likely to increase.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative during periods of employment growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in CPIAUCSL (CPI) above 215 indicates higher inflation, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns as inflation could lead to tighter monetary policy and reduced consumer purchasing power.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive when CPIAUCSL is above 215 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDPC1 (real GDP) coupled with a decrease in INDPRO (industrial production) suggests economic growth without corresponding supply increases, leading to potential inefficiencies and negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive when GDPC1 increases and INDPRO decreases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO (industrial production) above 115 indicates strong supply activity, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns as production increases can lead to higher corporate revenues.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not higher when INDPRO is above 115 (t-test p > 0.05).
